item.title: Ski Race Shut Down After Famous Bear Wanders On To Slope
item.description: A ski race in Alberta, Canada, had to be canceled due to the surprise arrival of a celebrity bear.

item.title: Australian Artist Collecting Lost Surfboard Fins Says Nearly Three-Quarters Are a Specific Brand
item.description: An Australian artist who has spent years collecting lost surfboard fins near Bells Beach says nearly three-quarters of those he’s found are a specific brand.

item.title: Telluride Ski Patrollers Vote to Go On Strike This Week
item.description: On Tuesday night, the Telluride Professional Ski Patrol Association voted to go on strike starting December 27.

item.title: Brazil Sends Five Young Surfers to Hawaii on $100,000 Olympic-Funded Trip
item.description: Brazil is going all in for Olympic success. The country's Olympic committee recently sent five young surfers to Hawaii to train and receive coaching.

item.title: Kai Lenny Wonders If ‘There Is a Limit to Big Wave Foiling’
item.description: Kai Lenny is an explorer. He's an explorer of his own limits. In March, a good opportunity arose to test the limits of big wave foiling... and his own.

item.title: The ‘Biggest Mullaghmore in 5 Years,’ as Told by Gearoid McDaid
item.description: Mullaghmore is not a place for the fair-weather surfer. Surfers like Gearoid McDaid thrive when things get hairy, and in December Mully was nothing if not that.

item.title: Kepa Acero, Natxo Gonzalez, and More Surf Perfect Mundaka
item.description: Kepa Acero, Natxo Gonzalez, and a few friends were lucky enough to score all-time Mundaka in December, and it was the best swell in five years.

item.title: Tom Servais and the Dying Art of Surf Photography
item.description: If surf photography isn't dead, it's certainly on life support. Iconic photographer Tom Servais talks about the state of his craft, and how lucky he truly was.

item.title: Chris Hemsworth Reports Back From a Christmas Surf Trip to Tavarua
item.description: Chris Hemsworth surfs a lot, and well. His latest enviable surf trip was a Christmas jaunt to Fiji's Tavarua Island Resort.

item.title: Telluride Ski Resort Announces Holiday Closure Due to Ski Patrol Labor Dispute
item.description: The Telluride Ski Patrol voted to go on strike beginning Saturday, December 27. The following day, Telluride Ski Resort announced an indefinite closure.
